user.title: GoodWe Time-of-Use
user.description: Connect to the GoodWe Wi-Fi/LAN dongle that talks to the inverter.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the inverter. Check the host, port and that the dongle is online.

data.export_hours: Max export duration at full power (hours)

set_cheapest_hours.name: Set cheapest hours
set_cheapest_hours.description: Plan the four Time-of-Use windows from the price forecast: charge fully in the cheapest hours and discharge in the most expensive ones (capped so the battery is not drained too early).

calculate_cheapest_hours.name: Calculate cheapest hours
calculate_cheapest_hours.description: Work out the cheapest charging and most expensive discharging hours from the price forecast and return the plan with the reasoning behind every window, without writing to the inverter.

set_windows.name: Set windows
set_windows.description: Write an explicit list of Time-of-Use windows to the inverter (start, stop, signed power and days).

forecast_soc.name: Forecast state of charge
forecast_soc.description: Project the battery state of charge from now until the end of tomorrow, following the Time-of-Use windows that are currently on the inverter. Returns a list of time/soc points.

get_activity.name: Get activity log
get_activity.description: Return the log of modifications sent to the inverter, newest first, optionally filtered by window and result.
